svg.title: Figure 07 · Replication error under discrete rebalancing
svg.desc: 5,000 GBM paths for each schedule; S₀ = K = 100, r = 5%, q = 0, σ = 20%, T = 1, seed 42. Every rebalance is self-financing. No transaction costs or jumps; the histogram window is −5 to +5.
